assumptions: H1 management fees and costs are repeated as a simple six-month run-rate only; this is not a live forecast.
Scenario PF is £20.0m, a normalized deterministic-model input. FY2025 disclosed PF revenue was £120.3m versus H1 2026 £8.9m, so H1 PF revenue is not doubled or otherwise annualized mechanically.
Scenario PF conversion uses the checked-in deterministic model's 45% bonus ratio, 2.5% overhead ratio, and 25% tax assumption, yielding 0.39375 after-tax contribution per £1 gross PF.
Scenario per-share values use 526.8m H1 APM shares. Statutory actuals use 519.3m basic and 557.8m diluted shares.
The checked-in valuation model's 500.851m shares are not used for accounting EPS; using them would require an explicit warning and is outside this page's EPS bridge.
limitations: Actual H1 PF revenue is IFRS-recognized revenue; projected crystallized PF in the deterministic model is an economic scenario and is not an accounting recognition forecast.
No live NAV, high-water-mark, fund-flow, or share-class data is available; this page must not be read as a live JUP valuation or forecast.
Other revenue/finance items and H1 underlying EPS were not supplied in the available context and are shown as unavailable rather than inferred.
Figures are internal research material and the page is deliberately excluded from public build allowlists.
